scores.note: Options 1-5 all include 'Romeo', which the sentence already has, so each reads 'even tells Romeo Romeo that': ungrammatical in place, 0. Also, 4 ('reminds') changes the meaning and 5 ('urges ... that') does not work with this sentence. Options 6-10 are duplicates. The verbs 'cautions' and 'advises' would have been usable.
